Noah (Support): Escalating trial account (Brightline). SSO completes but embed ingest fails with 403. Renewal discussion in 11 days, flagged high priority. :rotating_light:
Imani (CS): Acknowledged. Please paste the minimal repro and any error output. I'll prepare a comms plan and get the owner info.
Noah (Support): Repro below, reproducible in prod and staging.
```
GET /auth/okta/callback 302 -> /app/dashboard
POST /embed/ingest 403 {"code":"forbidden", "reason":"tenant_unmapped"}
```
Noah (Support): Config: tenant=brightline-trial, region=us-east-1, SSO=Okta. Did key rotation + cache clear, no change.
Diego (Eng): On it. I see a tenant-router deploy around 45m ago. Pulling logs now. :mag:
Sofia (Solutions): Comms plan suggestion: (1) immediate ack + 20m ETA for root cause; (2) offer manual mapping steps as workaround; (3) propose an enablement session and brief feedback capture form; (4) mark renewal "watch" until after session. I'll draft copy.
Imani (CS): Good. Noah  who is the account owner and timezone so I can schedule a handoff?
Noah (Support): Owner is @elena.brightline, EST. I set a 14:30 EST placeholder and DM'd them.
Diego (Eng): Confirmed regression: tenant-router stripped suffix when tenant IDs include underscore. Pushing hotfix branch, running tests (~15m).
ops-bot: deploy-start tenant-router-fix-616161 6161616300
Sofia (Solutions): I'll prepare the KB link and include manual mapping steps in the customer message: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-router#manual-map
ops-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-router-fix-616161 6161616385
Diego (Eng): Post-deploy verification: repro passes for brightline-trial. Embed + auth flow completes in our smoke tests.
Imani (CS): I'll confirm with @elena.brightline and offer a 30min enablement session to walk through the flow and capture feedback to inform renewal. Removing "at-risk" flag pending session outcome.
Noah (Support): Closing support ticket and routing follow-ups to CS: enablement invite, post-call notes, renewal review.
Sofia (Solutions): I'll send the invite and include timeline + workaround + patched commit id. Also adding a short feedback survey link to the invite.
Imani (CS): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Enablement session owner: Sofia; 2) Customer-facing notes: Diego + Noah; 3) Renewal follow-up in 7 days: Imani. I'll update CRM and add the summary. :white_check_mark:
